title: Autonomous Valve UDT end-to-end smoke test
goal: Prove that a coding agent can read a task from Git, make a small generator/example change, produce a Siemens SCL artifact, and have that exact artifact accepted by the trusted TIA Portal V21 gate.
scope: Create examples/valve.json describing a simple Valve device.
Use the existing vendor-neutral Domain -> PLC IR -> SiemensBackend path.
Add or update automated tests that prove the Valve artifact generation behavior.
Do not redesign the compiler architecture for this smoke task.
acceptance: examples/valve.json exists and represents the requested Valve fields using the existing AutomationDevice schema.
Automated tests cover the Valve generation path and remain deterministic.
Existing Motor tests and examples remain green.
GeneratorCli produces UDT_Valve.scl from examples/valve.json on Linux.
The generated UDT_Valve.scl is the artifact transferred to the trusted Windows acceptance job.
TIA Portal V21 imports/generates the tested artifact and compiles with zero errors.
